summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting entry into a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation. The registrant, J.P. Morgan Real Estate Income Trust, Inc., through its operating partnership, increased its existing unsecured revolving credit facility from $325 million to $550 million via an amendment dated August 27, 2026. Truist Bank remains administrative agent. No special-situation elements like acquisition, restructuring, or capital return are present; this is routine financing activity.
